description: An agent calling an action through the screen is refused: it uses the action's own tool, and a person-only action answers with the typed refusal.

problems.message: add_recipe_to_shopping_list is an action, and agents run actions through their own tool (MCP add_recipe_to_shopping_list), not through the person's screen.
recipe order: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can. Ask the person, who does it with Order ingredients on the recipe in the app.
